section.title: 1. Purpose and scope
section.p: This method sets out how the price of a parcel is determined from its size, its weight and its destination zone.
It applies to every parcel handed in at a counter. Pallets and letters are outside its scope.
The method is reviewed once a year by the pricing committee.

list.item: Actual weight (AW) is the weight of the parcel in kilograms as shown by the scale.
Dimensional weight (DW) is a weight derived from the volume of the parcel.
Chargeable weight (CW) is the weight on which the price is based.
The zone is the destination area of the parcel: Local, National or Abroad.

section.title: 3.1 Dimensional weight
section.p: The dimensional weight is obtained from the length L, the width W and the height H of the parcel, measured in centimetres.
The divisor of 5000 is fixed and is not varied by zone.

section.title: 3.2 Chargeable weight
section.p: The chargeable weight is the larger of the actual weight and the dimensional weight: CW = max(AW, DW).
The chargeable weight is never taken below 0.5 kilograms.
Weights are not rounded before the price is calculated.

section.title: 4.1 Zone rates
section.p: Each zone has a base rate and a rate per kilogram, as set out in Table 1.
Rates are stated in the currency of the counter and exclude tax.

section.title: 4.2 Price before surcharge
section.p: The price before surcharge is the base rate plus the rate per kilogram times the chargeable weight: P = B + R * CW.
B and R are taken from Table 1 for the zone of the parcel.

section.title: 4.3 Fuel surcharge
section.p: A fuel surcharge of 12.5% is added to the price before surcharge: S = P * (1 + 0.125).
The surcharge rate is set by the pricing committee and is the same for all zones.

section.title: 4.4 Volume discount
section.p: A customer who hands in n parcels at once receives a discount rate of 1% per parcel, capped at 20%: D = min(0.2, 0.01 * n).
The discount is applied to the price after surcharge.

section.title: 4.5 Minimum price
section.p: The final price is never below 4.50, whatever the zone and the discount.
Final prices are rounded to 2 decimals.

section.title: 5. Governance
section.p: Changes to Table 1 are approved by the pricing committee and recorded in the change log.
Questions about this method are answered by the pricing office.
